title: Export PcbLib footprints as PNG thumbnails
summary: Shows how to iterate a PCB library and render each footprint with PaintFootprintThumbnail into a bitmap handle, then save it as a PNG file from .NET, including a workaround for the overflowing typed result.
phrasings: render a footprint to a bitmap
generate thumbnails for every footprint in a library
convert an HBITMAP from Altium to a PNG file

commands.name: GenerateImage
commands.description: Export the footprints of a PCB library as PNG images
commands.params: Lib=<path to .PcbLib> (default: the focused PCB library)|Out=<folder> (default: temp folder)|Size=<pixels, 1-4096> (default 500)
